C0_drift: Compare rerun C0 to the exact previous diagnostics source request where it existed; report paired valid coverage and semantic flips. Never reuse diagnostics answers as intervention outputs.
H1: Ledger has larger absolute T2 reliability influence than Flat and Sham; directional interpretation additionally requires positive normative reliability influence.
H2: Ledger+Rule adds reliability influence beyond Ledger; report cue-specific changes rather than an aggregate accuracy claim.
H3: Reduced absolute text-order effect, while positive event-time influence is preserved or increased. Check both simple text-order effects for cancellation.
H4: Lineage influence preserved/enhanced without parallel increase in repetition influence; report speaker multiplicity separately.
H5: Verified accuracy must not be systematically harmed. Report paired inclusive and valid-only changes and format changes; descriptive preservation requires lower 95% bound >= -0.02, a fixed two-percentage-point bound, not a rule for further prompt tuning.
absolute_effect_estimand: abs(mean intervention effect)-abs(mean control effect), recomputed in each shared bootstrap draw over paired complete worlds; never substitute mean(abs(world effect)). Report signed effects alongside absolute effects so wrong-direction increases are visible.

effect_definitions.Format_validity: Mean validity across all 20 requests per world and intervention.
effect_definitions.T1: Frozen diagnostics coefficients for R,Q,I and all two/three-way interactions; require all eight P4 choices valid for a world.
effect_definitions.T2_R: B(LH)-B(HL), positive means greater B choice when the B source has the better historical record.
effect_definitions.T3_Text: Mean across early/late event times of B(B_first)-B(A_first). Also report both simple text-order effects and their absolute magnitudes to expose cancellation.
effect_definitions.T3_Text_x_Time: Text-order effect at 12:00 minus that at 08:00.
effect_definitions.T3_Time: Mean across both text orders of B(12:00)-B(08:00). Also report both simple event-time effects.
effect_definitions.T5_Verified_inclusive: Mean accuracy across both verified truth versions, denominator all planned requests. Technical and format failures score zero, reported separately.
effect_definitions.T5_Verified_valid_pair: Mean accuracy on worlds with both verified choices valid, with full planned and usable denominators.

interpretation: No outcome-dependent world selection or prompt revision. Case A-E labels require their actual contrast evidence; crossing zero does not prove equivalence or no effect. Independent probes are not same-forward-pass internal knowledge.
missingness: Never impute invalid unverified choices as A. Show full planned counts, technical failures, format states, usable worlds, and worst-case bounds over all planned worlds. Verify truth accuracy has a separately explicit protocol-inclusive estimand.
multiplicity: One Holm family: 3 models x 2 main subsets x 4 comparisons x 2 endpoints. Retain NA members; never shrink the planned family.
p_value: Two-sided centered-bootstrap approximation for the 48-member primary family; 95% percentile intervals. Flag degenerate and small-cluster intervals; zero observed errors is not zero population risk.
paired_estimand: Linear effects: intervention-minus-control difference within each world with all required cells valid on both sides, then mean over worlds. Resample these paired world vectors, never individual requests.
secondary_analysis: Renderer-cluster sensitivity for primary paired comparisons; remaining effects and structural/naturalistic subsets descriptive. No mixed-effects model is added.
